sources.title: AI Race to 100 Percent on the Bar Exam
sources.excerpt: More than two-thirds of the models scored higher than the average human test-taker.

reasoning: Multiple sources and studies verify that AI models can pass the US bar exam. While the original study's claim that GPT-4 scored in the 90th percentile (top 10%) was disputed by subsequent MIT research—which argued it actually scored around the 68th percentile—both studies confirm that the model successfully passed the exam. A score in the 68th percentile is still above the average human test-taker (the 50th percentile). Furthermore, newer AI models have continued to show improvement, with many consistently scoring above human averages.
